outcome: Maternal hepatic enzymes (Total bile acids, Direct bilirubin, ALT, AST)
cohort: The study included 27 participants (18 ICP patients and 9 healthy pregnancies) from whom placentas were collected.
finding: The study found elevated expression of GABRP, ATG14, and LC3 in ICP placentas compared to uncomplicated pregnancies, with GABRP expression associated with autophagy and correlated with total bile acid levels.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected immediately after cesarean section before labor onset.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was measured and found to be significantly lower in the severe ICP group.
gest_age: Gestational weeks were measured and found to be significantly lower in the severe ICP group.
